name: m-skills
description: A simple plugin for full-stack developers who use Claude for real work. Five commands are the everyday loop — brainstorm, plan, implement, review, document; the rest wait until you need them. Project-agnostic: every command, framework, and convention resolves at runtime from a per-project PROJECT-PROFILE.md instead of being hardcoded. The strictest rules — no staging or committing, no auto-accepted golden updates, no secrets written into tracked files — are enforced by hooks that deny the call, not by prose the model has to remember.
